contract.task_clause:
Which of the following has provided evidence that the Sun's atmosphere contains sodium atoms?
Option A: Absorption lines in the solar spectrum are consistent with the presence of sodium.
Option B: Stars with the same spectral class as the Sun are made mostly of sodium.
Option C: Solar samples returned to Earth by the Voyager spacecraft contained sodium.
Option D: The Sun gives off energy produced by the nuclear fusion of sodium in its core
